headline: EcoGraf - Fully hedged capital measure to accelerate anode strategy
summary: EcoGraf is launching a fully hedged share purchase program worth about AUD 2 million. The funds are intended to accelerate financing, offtake partner acquisition and its battery anode strategy.
why: EcoGraf is a graphite and battery anode developer, and its funding and offtake deals determine its progress in supplying battery materials.
